lines.text: After Samuel died and was buried in Ramah, David went to the Wilderness of Paran, and Nabal lived in Maon.
David sent ten young men to Nabal at Carmel to greet him and ask for whatever he could spare.
Nabal asked who David was, so David told his men to strap on their swords, and about six hundred followed.
Abigail loaded donkeys with bread, wine, sheep, raisins and figs, and met David in a mountain ravine without telling Nabal.
Abigail followed David's messengers with five maidens and became his wife, and Saul gave Michal to Palti of Hebron.
